body:
Question stem:
A calculator is permitted.

(a) Find the zeros of p and their multiplicities, and describe the end behavior of p using limit notation.

(b) Is x=-3 a local extremum of p? Justify your answer using the multiplicity of the zero, and contrast with the behavior at x=1.

(c) Using technology, approximate the coordinates of the local maximum of p.

Stimulus:
Let p(x) = -2(x-1)(x+3)^2.
